title: MyCard Prestige - Discontinued from 1st of October 2026
body:
The Mycard Prestige has been unavailable for applications for a few weeks now and they've recently updated some of the T&C's where they removed the Prestige from point earn tables beginning 1st of October.
On live chat they are providing the following:
Please be advised that your current MyCard Prestige rewards benefits will remain unchanged until 1 October 2026. Up until that date, you'll continue to earn rewards under your existing Prestige earn rate and program benefits.
From 1 October 2026, the rewards program changes will take effect, and the earn rate currently applicable to your MyCard Prestige card will change. The updated earn rate and rewards structure will apply from that date onwards.
Current state
Rate Domestic: 3 points per $1 on hotels, airlines, dining.
2 Points per $1 on Supermarkets, Petrol and National Retailers
1 Point per $1 on all Eligible Transactions
Future state (1 Oct)
1.5 points per $1 uncapped
2 points per $1 on travel and International spend
Current state
Uber Premier $100 cashback
Luxury Stay “4th Night on Us”
Lounge visits: 15 visits shared with guest
Future state (1 Oct)
Priority Pass Standard Membership
2 Complimentary lounge visits per membership year*
Available to Primary Cardholder only
Your annual fee will be changed as well from $700 to $300.
Australian premium credit card market is looking dire now.
